title: W08d: package assembly and installation procedure
description: Assemble the single integration package and its documented installation procedure: plugin.yaml, the assembly and registration entrypoint, generated tool contracts, the registry, the worker modules, the dashboard backend, the built native plugin artifact, tests and a README. Runtime artifacts are built or copied by the documented procedure rather than by forking Hermes core, and the package installs as one folder into the selected native Hermes installation with explicit project MCP routes, toolsets, plugin grants and both backend and native enablement configured. Implementation baseline: merged main 6276d5f / ledger closure e64d4bd, Waystation 0.6.0 on Bun 1.4.1; see docs/reconciliation-2026-09-27.md. Reuse the merged foundation and its tests. Replace the no-op register(ctx) and unadvertised desktop placeholder only when the implemented worker/backend/native contributions are assembled. Own reproducible folder assembly, manifest/entrypoint wiring and installation/uninstall procedure tests in an isolated Hermes home. W09 verifies the assembled candidate end to end; W10 owns the final versioned artifact and rollout to the selected real installation. Reuse W07c's host capability evidence and recheck build drift rather than duplicating its capability probes.
acceptance: One assembled candidate folder installs into an isolated Hermes home matching the selected native build and enables both halves without a separate repository or catalog publication; real rollout stays W10.
The built native artifact imports only what the plugin fence allows, and generated contracts are present rather than regenerated at runtime.
Uninstalling leaves the canonical ledger untouched, does not release claims, and preserves plugin configuration for reinstall.
The procedure names the Hermes home it targets and does not modify Hermes core files.
notes:
W08 owns manifests and assembly; W07 contributes one registration entrypoint.

Reconciliation finding: current register(ctx) is deliberately a no-op scaffold with no tools/routes. Assemble and test the W08b profile-state bridge and W08c native artifact; verify runtime and desktop exports against the installed Hermes build before enabling contributions.
